title: Different quality for different orders
text:
Different quality for different orders. These humidifier packs seem to work perfectly, and according to my hygrometer they keep the humidity stable to within +/- 2%, which keeps things fresh and smooth quite effortlessly.

I will definitely be making use of these on an ongoing basis!

[Edited to add (June 23 2015)]

The most recent order I received, which was likely fulfilled by a different source, was of very poor quality. Unlike previous orders where the humidifier packets were shipped in a thick plastic package that was well sealed and appeared to be designed to retain the moisture of the humidifier packets, this most recent order was shipped in a flimsy zip-lock bag with very thin (and worn) plastic, and all of the packets were crystallized and had little moisture left. They were essentially useless and a complete waste of money.

It's unfortunate that Amazon lists them both under the same product ID so that I cannot differentiate between the batches. Clearly some batches are better than others, so buyer beware.

I have changed my rating from five stars down to three stars to reflect the variable quality of the product.
